3217.title: Programmatic rename dialog drops prior editor focus
3217.rootCauseOneLine: The controlled rename shell opens without a dialog trigger and never captures or restores the previously focused element after close.
3217.proposedFix: Capture the active element when the shared rename shell opens and restore it from DialogContent's post-close callback when it remains connected.
3217.caveats: The direct evidence is a production-component jsdom focus test; no live desktop screenshot was needed for the DOM focus-state defect.
